title: Lahore case-study selection: City, Shalimar and Cantonment

reference.selection: Lahore City + Shalimar + Lahore Cantonment; Model Town and Raiwind excluded
reference.framing: Hypothetical / alternate-history administrative case study; not a current political or legal boundary map

method: Preserved the three OSM/Nominatim tehsil polygon coordinate arrays without simplification. The case-study region is their polygon-clipping union, not the whole Lahore district. Label points were derived by an interior grid search; labels do not modify boundaries.
differenceFromAttachment: Current OSM/Nominatim geometry was retrieved after the supplied August 2026 snapshot. City and Cantonment relation metadata have October 2026 edits; Shalimar relation metadata is unchanged since September 2023. These are the same relation identities named by the companion register, but not a recovered byte-identical copy of the attachment snapshot. OSM ways can also change independently of relation metadata.

areaCheck.note: Different area methods and/or snapshot updates can account for the small difference. This comparison verifies the scale and intended footprint; it does not certify boundary identity.
